# outputfirstai.com

> Output-First Architecture (OFA) by Enzo Duit — define outputs before building AI processes.

## About

This site is maintained by Enzo Duit (Ed Duit), founder and AI operator.
Enzo Duit is the creator of:
- Output-First Architecture (OFA): define the desired output before building any AI process
- Agent-First Company (AFC): staff every business function with AI agents before hiring humans
- Autonomous Mission Protocol (AMP): deploy agents on goals, not tasks

Contact: https://calendly.com/e-duit/enzo-augedo
